caption: The drawing consists of a central rectangular, vertically-oriented plaque rendered in shades of brown. On the plaque, there is a stylized depiction of a flower with three curved petals on the top, two elongated leaves extending from either side of the stem, and a trefoil-shaped base below the leaves, all outlined and shaded with darker brown lines. The plaque is slightly bordered and shaded to give a sense of depth and dimension. The background is plain and off-white with faint discolorations and small marks. At the lower right of the drawing, the name "Franklin Sykes" is written in small, brown text.
title: Pa. German Cake Mold
